run.question: Search the 'app-183c-logs' index for ERROR level log messages. What error codes (format ERR-XXXX) appear in the logs?

report.summary: Within the sampled window (documents dated 2026-11-22T09:52:00Z through 2026-11-22T10:17:00Z), the app-183c-logs index contained exactly 7 documents as reported by the index listing, and a match_all query on timestamp over 2026-11-22T09:18:41Z–2026-11-22T10:18:41Z returned all 7 (total relation eq, documents_omitted 0). Exactly 3 of them have level=ERROR, each carrying a distinct ERR-XXXX code: ERR-9463 (service inventory-api, 'Stock sync failed - ERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503', 10:12:00Z), ERR-4058 (service order-service, 'Payment validation failed - ERR-4058: Invalid card number format', 10:02:00Z) and ERR-7291 (service payment-api, 'Database connection timeout - ERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s', 09:57:00Z). The remaining 4 documents are INFO/WARN and carry no error_code field. This is a log-lookup answer only: no metric, trace or Kubernetes evidence was queried, so no causal or health conclusion about the listed services is drawn.

claims.text: A level=ERROR term query on app-183c-logs (time field timestamp, 2026-11-22T09:18:41Z to 2026-11-22T10:18:41Z) returned total 3 documents, documents_omitted 0, all three with distinct error_code values ERR-9463, ERR-4058 and ERR-7291.
ERR-9463: message 'Stock sync failed - ERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503' from service inventory-api at timestamp 2026-11-22T10:12:00Z, level ERROR.
ERR-4058: message 'Payment validation failed - ERR-4058: Invalid card number format' from service order-service at timestamp 2026-11-22T10:02:00Z, level ERROR.
ERR-7291: message 'Database connection timeout - ERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s' from service payment-api at timestamp 2026-11-22T09:57:00Z, level ERROR.

An unfiltered match_all query on app-183c-logs over the same window returned 7 documents (total eq 7, documents_omitted 0): the 3 ERROR documents above plus 4 documents with no error_code field — INFO 'Service started successfully' (payment-api, 09:52:00Z), WARN 'Retrying database connection' (payment-api, 09:58:00Z), INFO 'Processing order batch complete' (order-service, 10:07:00Z) and INFO 'Recovered from temporary outage' (inventory-api, 10:17:00Z).

The mapping of index app-183c-logs defines fields error_code (keyword), level (keyword), message (text), service (keyword) and timestamp (date); there is no @timestamp field, which is why the query first failed with TIME_FIELD_REQUIRED and was re-run with time_field=timestamp.

The index listing reported app-183c-logs as green/open with docs.count 7 and store.size 9.2kb at query time, consistent with the 7 documents returned by the unfiltered query covering the 1-hour window.

Whether ERR-9463, ERR-4058 or ERR-7291 reflects a live fault in inventory-api, order-service or payment-api cannot be judged from these log lines alone; the log set is tiny and self-reports recovery (INFO 'Recovered from temporary outage' at 10:17:00Z after ERR-9463). Verifying would require these services' own error-rate and latency metrics plus traces.
